# Carry › Type-Led

**What belongs here.** A word or title stays while the scene rebuilds around it.

**Examples.** headline stays as the background changes

**Family test.** Is there an element the eye follows from A into B that stays the same thing throughout?

Each transition here has its own folder named by its id (lowercase, hyphens). See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../CONTRIBUTING.md).
